edit.description: repo_file_set descends only the literal prefixes of the globs it resolves, still raw disk
paths-match caller hands the globs it resolves
large ignored tree outside every resolved prefix stays unread

summary: The raw-disk paths-match walk reads only as far as the globs it resolves reach, instead of the whole tree including target/ and .git/
acceptance: Over a generated fixture with a large ignored tree outside every resolved glob's literal prefix, a check reads nothing under it; a gitignored file inside a resolved glob still counts
tests: a check reads nothing under a large ignored tree outside every resolved glob prefix
pins: repo file set stays raw disk including gitignored targets
notes: Answers the closed question repo-file-set-raw-disk-vs-one-fenced-index. A glob with no literal prefix (leading **) still walks from the root. The read count needs a pin of its own; walkdir bypasses bytes::open, so build picks the counter.
